item.title: Hearings for three data center rezonings to begin
item.description: Columbia County’s new Data Center (D-C) district zoning is getting its first hearings, tonight, as the Columbia County Planning Commission hears three separate rezoning requests for large, neighboring rural tracts to make way for data facility development. The post Hearings for three data center rezonings to begin appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Mayakoba’s El Camaleón to host 2027 Latin America Amateur Championship
item.description: Mayakoba’s El Camaleón course in Playa del Carmen, Mexico, will host the 2027 Latin America Amateur Championship (LAAC), tournament organizers announced Thursday, Jan. 15. The post Mayakoba’s El Camaleón to host 2027 Latin America Amateur Championship appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Schonbaum, Martínez Benedetti share early lead at Latin America Amateur
item.description: Argentina’s Andy Schonbaum and Venezuela’s Andrés Martínez Benedetti shared the first-round lead at the Latin America Amateur Championship (LAAC) on Thursday, Jan. 15, each shooting a four-under-par 66 at Lima Golf Club. The post Schonbaum, Martínez Benedetti share early lead at Latin America Amateur appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Sheriff Whittle is phasing out dash cams, even as critics renew call for body cameras
item.description: The Columbia County Sheriff’s Office is slowly ending the use of dash cameras in patrol cars. Sheriff Clay Whittle says the cameras cost too much, wear out quickly and have been replaced by newer tools. The post Sheriff Whittle is phasing out dash cams, even as critics renew call for body cameras appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Error in state auditors’ data center review inflated job production and economic value
item.description: Data centers in Georgia did not produce the same high payback in exchange for nearly half a billion dollars in tax breaks as reported by state auditors last month, according to a correction issued Wednesday. The post Error in state auditors’ data center review inflated job production and economic value appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: Gov. item.title: Six seeking Allen’s 12th Congressional District seat
item.description: As Georgia’s 12th Congressional District heads toward the 2026 election, a growing field of candidates including five Democrats and one Republican is lining up to unseat Rep. Rick Allen. The post Six seeking Allen’s 12th Congressional District seat appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County Planning Commission votes to recommend approval for all three rezoning requests for data center development
item.description: The Columbia County Planning Commission has voted to recommend approval for all three of the controversial rezoning requests in the county’s District 4, all to make way for proposed data center developments. The post Columbia County Planning Commission votes to recommend approval for all three rezoning requests for data center development appeared first on The Augusta Press.
